tools.name: refund_eligibility
tools.description: Evaluate a US consumer subscription refund against versioned source-backed rules. Returns UNKNOWN when required conditions are absent or the vendor requires approval or manual policy review.

tools.name: cancellation_penalty
tools.description: Check US subscription cancellation terms without executing cancellation. Known vendors include review-only and retired scopes: their presence is not automation support. Adobe requires manual contract review. Typeform requires Basic, direct/self-serve platform scope and returns CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END,

tools.name: return_eligibility
tools.description: Evaluate whether a US consumer subscription purchase can be reversed under versioned source-backed rules. Returns UNKNOWN when required conditions are absent or manual review is required.

tools.name: trial_terms
tools.description: Evaluate a live US consumer subscription trial offer. Supply observed availability, duration, card, and auto-conversion facts; the tool returns UNKNOWN instead of inferring current offers from static data.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "cancellation_penalty" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Evaluate whether cancelling a US consumer subscription incurs a penalty or lock. Returns UNKNOWN when billing cadence is required or the policy needs manual review." → after: "Check US subscription cancellation terms without executing cancellation. Known vendors include review-only and retired scopes: their presence is not automation support. Adobe requires manual contract review. Typeform requires Basic, direct/self-serve platform scope and returns CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END, "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
